thread:
alex: Heads-up — need alignment on acceptance criteria for customer edge handshake for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem). Customer asked for customer-managed egress + BGP handoff. Key questions: what do we require from customer networking, what do we validate during onboarding, and what are rollback gates?

mei: +1. Can we split criteria into Network prereqs, Validation tests, and Failure modes? Also IPv6 support? :thinking: 

jorge: Suggest Network prereqs: 1) BGP session params + ASN, 2) Static egress IPs (if SNAT) or explicit route leak policy, 3) TLS between control plane and connector allowed, 4) Customer ACLs for health checks (esp 443/5222). Validation tests: BGP session established, route learned, outbound traffic shows customer IP, control plane <-> connector health. Failure modes: BGP flap, overlapping prefixes, asymmetric routing, NAT hairpin.

sophie: Product note — for GA we promised either predictable egress IPs or a documented shared-NAT fallback. Need explicit customer opt-in if they want shared fallback. Launch gate: no unresolved overlapping-IP ambiguity and a documented rollback path.

deploy-bot: RFC doc created: https://r.redwood/rfc/customer-edge-handshake — please add acceptance criteria checklist.

alex: Draft for validation steps (quick):
```
1) BGP session up and stable for 10m
2) Announced prefix seen in provider fabric (route table)
3) 5/5 controlplane->connector health checks pass for 5m
4) E2E request shows source IP matching announced egress IP for 30 samples
```
alex: also add test for connector reconnect and KV cache warm-up/consistency after failover.

mei: Edge cases: customer rotates ASN during onboarding, customer NATs internal IPs before egress (obscures validation), IPv6-only customers, overlapping RFC1918 ranges when using direct peering, and customers with strict egress ACLs that block health checks. Add timeouts for route withdrawal and BFD flaps.

jorge: Ops playbook snippet to validate on customer side:
```
# run from support box
tcpdump -nni eth0 "tcp port 179" # watch BGP handshake
curl -v https://controlplane.internal/health
traceroute -n <customer-egress-ip>
# verify egress IP with: curl -s https://ifconfig.redwood/v4
```

sophie: Can we map owners? eng-platform -> protocol & validation tests, eng-oncall -> runbook + escalation, security -> ACL/KMS signoff, solutions -> customer comms. Timeline: draft PRD by next Wed, internal review week after, GA gating 2 weeks after signoff.

alex: I'll put together PRD + granular acceptance checklist and include fallback policy text (explicit opt-in). Will ping for a short sync after draft. :thumbsup:

mei: Thanks — tagging @sophie for product gating.

sophie: Ack. I'll review the checklist and call out any compliance gaps.

alex: Closing loop — added a note to the RFC about rollback: automatic switch to shared-NAT within 3m if BGP flaps > 5 times in 10m, and manual remediation for overlapping-prefix conflicts.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: from jorge, :eyes: from mei)
